home-agents.alt: Home in the Grounded app for a team member: cards for the agents they can use (Go docs, Help Desk Assistant, HR Answers and Library Guide), each with its team and audience, and their latest conversations below.

discover-agents.alt: Discover agents: the agents a signed-in person can use, grouped by their own teams, the organisation and public.

chat-answer-with-claims.alt: A Help Desk Assistant answer to "I forgot my NetID password. How do I reset it?": numbered steps with citation chips marked with check marks, one sentence marked Uncited, the summary "5 of 6 claims supported · 1 uncited", and the two sources opened below.

chat-citation-card.alt: The same answer with a citation chip's card open: "Claim supported by this source (100% confidence)", the claim's text, the cited passage, and "Show source 1 below".

public-agent-page.alt: A public agent's page, used without signing in: the Library Guide answering "How do I book a study room?" with citations.

team-overview.alt: An IT Help Desk team's Overview for its owner: counts of data sources, knowledge bases, agents and documents; evaluation scores with one set down 17 points; spend this month against a $50 budget, not enforced; and recent changes.

data-source-web.alt: A web data source's Overview: pages crawled, passages indexed, repeated blocks removed and the next scheduled sync.

source-documents-ocr.alt: An upload source's Documents tab: status filters including Needs OCR, and its documents with kind, size, status and passages, among them a scanned PDF.

source-document-ocr.alt: The scanned PDF's record page, saying it was read with OCR (Tesseract), with the passage its text produced.

crawl-domains.alt: Data sources, Crawl domains tab: the team's domain requests with their status.

kb-try-it.alt: A knowledge base's Try it tab with Judge with SystemOne on: the question "What are the computer lab hours?", ten results, SystemOne keeping 1 of the 10 passages, and the top passage, from a scanned PDF, with its scores.

agent-build.alt: The agent editor's Build tab for Help Desk Assistant: the instructions and the collapsed Model, Knowledge, Answering, Safety, SystemOne checks and Advanced sections, beside the Try it panel with a draft answer, its claim summary and Add to evaluations.

agent-share.alt: An agent's Share tab: a widget key with its allowed origins, the embed code with the launcher position, and a live preview of the widget with the agent's welcome and starter questions.

agent-versions.alt: The agent's version menu in the editor header, with Version history, Compare versions and Revert draft.

agent-analytics.alt: An agent's Analytics tab, Usage view: conversations, answers, satisfaction, citations supported and refusals over the last 30 days, and answers per day.

evaluations-runs.alt: An evaluation set's Runs tab: three completed retrieval runs scoring 100%, 100% and 83%, and the score-over-time chart with markers where results per search changed.

evaluations-result.alt: A failed retrieval result: the expected document, found at #4 beyond the top 3, beside the two documents that came back, with Try this search, Open expected document and Edit question.

evaluations-answer-result.alt: A full-answer result: the agent's answer with its citations, citing the expected document, mentioning the required phrase, with all its claims supported.

team-evaluations.alt: The team's Evaluations page: two sets with what they test, their questions, latest score and trend (one down 17 points), and the Regressions filter.

team-members.alt: Team settings, Members tab: the team's only owner, an editor marked "Managed by SSO group it-staff", and two members whose roles can be changed.

team-usage-spend.alt: Team settings, Usage & spend tab: "$0.03 of $50.00 this month · Within budget · not enforced · resets Oct 1" with a meter, and the spend breakdown by agent and by model.

team-api-keys.alt: Team settings, API keys tab: personal and service keys with their scopes, restrictions, expiry and last use.

admin-overview-features.alt: Admin Overview: the platform at a glance, Needs attention, and the Features card listing each optional feature's state, with recent changes.

admin-teams.alt: Admin, Teams: every team with its approved classification, members and status.

admin-sso-groups.alt: Admin, SSO groups: one rule mapping the it-staff group to the Editor role in the IT Help Desk team, the claim read at sign-in, and how many people's last sign-in carried it.

admin-sso-groups-dry-run.alt: The Add rule dialog with its dry run: one person would be added to the team when the rule is saved.

admin-connections.alt: Admin, Connections: three OpenAI-compatible connections (a model gateway, an embedding service and a SystemOne service) with their base URLs.

admin-models.alt: Admin, Models: a chat model, an embedding model and a SystemOne model with their connection, maximum classification, what uses them and their status, above filters by kind.

admin-embedding-migrations.alt: Admin, Embedding profiles, Migrations tab: a knowledge base moving to a new profile, with per-source progress.

admin-classifications.alt: Admin, Classifications: the levels Open, Sensitive and Restricted with their maximum audience and retention.

admin-moderation.alt: Admin, Moderation: the policy for the public audience with a threshold and action for each category.

admin-costs.alt: Admin, Costs, Overview tab for the last 30 days: total spend, tokens, requests and unpriced usage, and spend per day by kind.

admin-costs-budgets.alt: Admin, Costs, Budgets tab: each team's mode, monthly budget, spend this month and projection.

admin-parsing-ocr.alt: Admin, Parsing & OCR: OCR turned on with the Tesseract backend and its languages.

admin-retention.alt: Admin, Retention: the retention period for each kind of data, with the Dry run, Runs and Legal holds tabs.

admin-break-glass.alt: Admin, Break-glass: sessions with their team, scope, reason, status and read counts.

admin-analytics.alt: Admin, Analytics: platform answers per day and usage totals, without message content.

audit-log.alt: Admin, Logs, Audit log: recent changes with who made them, the area and the target.
